title: _FILE_VERB_RE and _C_PAYLOAD_RE are quadratic, and a slow hook passes the tool call
detail: _FILE_VERB_RE can start at every char of a run of / or ~ or ./ because its lookbehind allows them: 48KB of / takes 26s in _may_write, which runs on every Bash call, and the 15s hook timeout then lets the call through ungated. _C_PAYLOAD_RE takes 5s on 'python ' repeated to 56KB. Measured on 0.238.2 by sweeping the gate's entry points.
